- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Essential steps in creating a minimalist wardrobe include: 
  1. Assessing current wardrobe
  2. Identifying key pieces (e.g., classic white shirt, little black dress, well-fitted jeans)
  3. Sticking to a color scheme (one or two neutral shades like black, white, or grey)
  4. Investing in quality pieces made from durable materials
  5. Accessorizing wisely with timeless items
  6. Donating or selling unwanted items
  7. Buying second-hand items from thrift stores or online marketplaces.
- [USER] User struggles with letting go of sentimental pieces, even if they are no longer worn.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for overcoming attachment to sentimental pieces include:
  1. Taking a picture of the item before letting it go
  2. Considering passing it on to someone who values it
  3. Repurposing the item into something new
  4. Keeping the memories rather than the item
  5. Giving oneself time to let go.
